title: Epidemiology of Acromegaly in Denmark 1991-2010
brief_summary: Aim: To assess the incidence rate, morbidity and mortality of acromegaly in Denmark.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* diagnosed with acromegaly in years 1991-2010
study_population: The entire danish population in the period 1991-2010 by means of national register
